title: Root
description: One knowledge base this machine knows: a registered or running local clone, or a codespace stack recorded here. Registration, the directory, the stack and the forward are separate facts, each stated as it is.

path.description: For a local root: the clone's path.

present.description: For a local root: whether the directory exists. A registered root whose directory is gone is kept, and says so.

current.description: For a local root: how the control server's own directory selects it, when it does — standing in it (cwd), or SEMIONT_ROOT.

running.description: Whether a stack of it is recorded on this machine.

lastUsed.description: When a command last used it, in RFC 3339, as the registry records it.

identityError.description: Why its identity could not be read from its clone, when it could not.

config.description: The Inference document a start of it runs, as the registry records it.

configs.description: For a present local root: the Inference documents its clone has, as start --config names them.

codespace.description: For a codespace root: the codespace's name.

codespaceState.description: For a codespace root: GitHub's word for the codespace's state (Available, Shutdown), when gh answered.

forwardPort.description: For a codespace root: the port on this machine its knowledge base is forwarded to, when one is recorded.

forwarded.description: For a codespace root: whether the recorded forward is alive.

reachable.description: For a codespace root: whether its knowledge base answers through the forward.
